title: Pharmaceutical Applications of UV/Vis & Assay of Multicomponent Formulations

governing_formulas: A_{\lambda 1} = \varepsilon_{X1} b c_X + \varepsilon_{Y1} b c_Y \quad \text{and} \quad A_{\lambda 2} = \varepsilon_{X2} b c_X + \varepsilon_{Y2} b c_Y

cognitive_progression.level_1_remember: Define fundamental laws, terminology, and bounds of Pharmaceutical Applications of UV/Vis & Assay of Multicomponent Formulations.
cognitive_progression.level_2_understand: Explain underlying physical mechanisms, instrumentation, and energy transitions.
cognitive_progression.level_3_apply: Solve quantitative analytical calculations using $$A_{\lambda 1} = \varepsilon_{X1} b c_X + \varepsilon_{Y1} b c_Y \quad \text{and} \quad A_{\lambda 2} = \varepsilon_{X2} b c_X + \varepsilon_{Y2} b c_Y$$.
cognitive_progression.level_4_analyze: Interpret spectral shifts, evaluate deviations, and troubleshoot analytical anomalies.

pedagogical_boundary.retained_scope: Simultaneous equation method for binary mixtures without separation, absorbance ratio (Q-analysis) method, derivative spectrophotometry (first and second derivative zero-crossing methods to eliminate excipient scatter), photometric titrations, pharmacopoeial assay of Paracetamol, Aspirin, and Iron-orthophenanthroline complex.
pedagogical_boundary.non_forced_clinical_rationale: This session naturally involves quantitative pharmaceutical active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) assay procedures per British and United States Pharmacopoeias. Applications are analytical quality control assays, NOT clinical prescribing.
pedagogical_boundary.excluded_scope: Biological fluid matrix extractions (deferred to advanced bioanalytical courses).

vision_filtering.policy: Separate core educational diagrams from decorative slide artifacts
